raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

The quantized (fp8) branch of the async weight sync feeds every bucket straight into `load_quanted_weights`. For a model with `tie_word_embeddings=True` the trainer state dict carries both `model.embed_tokens.weight` and its alias `lm_head.weight`, and the two can land in different buckets. vLLM 0.29 checks skipped aliases per `load_weights` call, so a bucket that carries only the alias fails the check and the first sync aborts:

```
ValueError: 'lm_head.weight' was skipped because it is tied to 'model.embed_tokens.weight' in Qwen3ForCausalLM, but 'model.embed_tokens.weight' was not found in the checkpoint, so the tied weight is uninitialized.
```

The standard (non-quantized) branch already filters the alias through `drop_tied_alias_updates` (#7973); the fp8 branch was left out. This PR applies the same filter there, including the MTP drafter call, and adds a CPU regression test.

Reproduced with Qwen3-0.6B, `actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization=fp8`, vLLM 0.29.0: the first weight sync failed before the fix and a 3-step GRPO run completed after it.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+tied+embedding+fp8 and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+drop_tied_alias_updates (only #7973, which covers the standard branch)
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

```
python -m pytest tests/utils/test_vllm_weight_name_normalization_on_cpu.py -q
# 28 passed (vLLM 0.29.0); the new test fails on main and passes with the fix
```

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/workers/rollout/vllm_rollout/utils.py`: pass `param_updates` through `drop_tied_alias_updates` before `load_quanted_weights` (main model and drafter).
- `tests/utils/test_vllm_weight_name_normalization_on_cpu.py`: `test_quantized_sync_drops_tied_alias_updates`.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used; every changed line was reviewed and the tests above were run by the submitter.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting).
- [x] Add / Update the documentation: not needed.
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s): CPU test above, collected by the existing CPU unit-test workflow.
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in the `ci-request` channel.

+def test_quantized_sync_drops_tied_alias_updates(monkeypatch):
+    """The quantized branch loads per bucket like the standard one, so it must drop the alias too."""
+    pytest.importorskip("vllm")
+    model = _FakeTiedModel(torch.zeros(2))
+    model.named_parameters = lambda remove_duplicate=False: iter(())
+    model.named_buffers = lambda: iter(())
+    worker = _make_worker(model)
+    loaded = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(_vllm_rollout_utils, "is_quantized_model", lambda config: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        _vllm_rollout_utils,
+        "load_quanted_weights",
+        lambda weights, runner, is_drafter=False: loaded.extend(name for name, _ in weights) or [],
+    )
+    updates = [("lm_head.weight", torch.ones(2)), ("q.weight", torch.ones(1))]
+
+    worker._update_weights(updates, peft_config=None, base_sync_done=False)
+
+    assert loaded == ["q.weight"]
+
